description: Variation of condition 5 (approved plans) to allow changes to the fenestration of planning permission 01054/AN/P16 approved 29/11/2005 for the redevelopment of the site for industrial purposes falling within Class B1(C) light industrial, B2 general industrial and B8 storage and distribution and associated parking
site_name: Land On The South Side Of
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of the sitting, design and external appearance of the building(s), the means of access there to and landscaping of the site approved on 15/08/2006 under application 01054/AN/P16(A).

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Previously approved plans: 
1046/16 Schedule of finishes, 1457/LA01 Rev B: planting proposals, location plan
Received: 12/07/2005
New Plans:
5395-PL-002 Block plan, 5395-PL-010 Floor plans, 5395-PL-020 Elevations, 5395-PL-030 Cross section
Received: 08/02/2022

Condition : 3 - No more than 1920m2 of floorspace, to include no more than 555m2 of ancillary office space, shall be included within the development hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of both hard and soft landscaping approved on 09/09/2008 under 01054/AN/P16(7).

Condition : 5 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details. The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority.

Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected approved on 20/07/2007 under 01054/AN/P16(B). The boundary treatment shall be completed before the building(s) is/are occupied.
Condition : 7 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Landscape management plan approved on 20/07/2007 under 01054/AN/P16(C)
Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the external materials approved on 26/04/2007 under 01054/AN/P16(D).

Condition : 9 - The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as industrial purposes falling within Classes B1(c) light industrial, B2 general industrial and B8 storage and distribution and shall not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 10 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal divison without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 11 - The processing, packaging and storage of commerical goods shall not take place anywhere on the site expect within the building.
Condition : 12 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 13 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials approved on 10/07/2007 under 01054/AN/P16(E)
Condition : 14 - The building shall not be occupied until a means of access for (pedestrians and/or cyclists) has been constructed in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 5395-PL-002.

Condition : 15 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 5395-PL-002 and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 16 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the provision made for disabled people to gain access to the building approved on 29/05/2007 under 01054/AN/P16(H). The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 17 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the site investigation details approved on 06/01/2020 under application 01054/AN/P16(21). All such measures shall be implemented before the development is occupied or such other date as may be required by the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 18 - No soakaways shall be constructed in contaminated ground
Condition : 19 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the site drainage system details approved on 20/07/2007 under 01054/AN/P16(I)

Condition : 20 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the site investigation and appropriate mitigation measures approved on 06/01/2020 under 01054/AN/P16(24). The development shall then proceed in strict accordance with the measures approved.

Condition : 21 - No development of the site shall commence until visbility splays to current national standards of 4.5 metres by 120 metres have been provided. The visibility splays shall, thereafter, be kept free of all obstructions to visibility above a height of 0.6 metres above the carriageway level.

Condition : 22 - The development hereby approved shall not be taken in to use until space for vehicle parking and turning has been provided. This area shall, thereafter, be kept available for parking and turning of private motor cars, light goods and lorries (HGV) at all times.
